label: v149
changes: The update notice was showing you v138's notes on every release since — the changelog file was hand-written and hadn't been updated in ten deploys. The build now refuses to start if it goes stale again.

Scanned referrals, lab results, X-ray requests and sick notes now file into Referrals & Results on the person's Medical tab — not just into Documents. Repeat results of the same test group together as a history you can open by date.
Vaccination cards and visas/residence permits can now be filed from a photo too. All three were invisible to the assistant before, which is why scans kept landing in the wrong place.
You can delete or amend any of those by voice now — including marking a referral as booked or done.
Reminders now cover passports, residence permits and check-ups, and tomorrow's diary the night before. They arrive at 90, 30, 7 and 0 days — never daily — and as one message, not one per item.
New Emergency readiness card: it works out what's missing from what you've already saved, rather than asking you to fill in a survey. Every gap taps through to the screen that fixes it.
There's finally a field to type an emergency contact — until now only the assistant could set one.
Fun photo lab: pick a ready-made style and it generates in the background, so you can close it and carry on. It tells you when it's ready.
Scrolling on the dimmed area behind a pop-up no longer drags the page underneath.
A new Security tab (next to Privacy and Terms) says plainly what Teluva can and cannot see. Worth a read.
Connecting Google Drive no longer asks permission to delete your files, and Calendar no longer asks to manage all your calendars.
